$comment: Profile selection for the showcase. Override with SHOWCASE_PROFILE=<id>. This file is public and carries no customer-specific identifier. Neutrality is enforced structurally, by the rules below, rather than by listing real names.

repository.$comment: This public repository's own coordinates. The standalone export needs them to rewrite sibling links to absolute URLs.
repository.name: agentic-engineering-loop-demo

neutrality.$comment: Two structural rules keep this public repository customer-neutral. First, no profile may carry a concrete organisation, tenant, subscription or directory value: those fields are null or a documented placeholder, and the target is supplied on the command line. Second, attendee-facing documents may use only the proper nouns allowed below, so an unrecognised name fails the build instead of being published quietly. A presenter who needs to check for engagement-specific terms puts them in an untracked .showcase.local.json; see .showcase.local.example.json. That file is never committed.
neutrality.$sceneWordsComment: Capitalised scene, badge and section words used in the run of show. They are not proper nouns, but they appear mid-sentence in headings and routing text.
